name: Leire Pajín, Aurelijus Veryga - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text:
1. The report sets a bigger EU fund for disasters and health emergencies: EUR 12.416 billion, split between civil protection, health and a flexible part. It renames the crisis coordination hub and puts it inside the emergency response centre. It adds rules on volunteers, climate risks, stockpiling medicines, and safety for deployed staff. It opens help to third countries, ties aid in conflicts to humanitarian law, and requires partnerships with developing countries and local responders.

- Bigger EU emergency fund: EUR 12.416 billion for disasters and health crises.
- Safer deployments: new duty-of-care rules for staff and volunteers sent abroad.
- Wider reach: third countries can ask for help; aid must follow humanitarian law.
